analysis.reasonEn: Wait-and-see stance maintained for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram has turned positive from negative, showing improvement but still in bearish convergence. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, indicating the start of a Higher Low pattern, but low volume reduces confidence. Weekly ADX at 46.5 suggests a clear trend, yet the possibility of a pullback after recent volatility on the daily chart remains.
